svg.title: Flare SM70 prefill and time to first token
svg.desc: Time to first token against prompt length on one Tesla V100 PCIe 32 GB, package f21b9abb with 512-token prefill chunks on server binary 48b69ed4, 2026-10-24, uncached prompts: 2,048 tokens: 2.06 s and 994 tok/s alone (previous package 807), 7.82 s and 954 tok/s aggregate with four; 8,192 tokens: 8.53 s and 961 tok/s alone (previous package 785), 33.95 s and 945 tok/s aggregate with four; 22,528 tokens: 25.08 s and 898 tok/s alone (previous package 741), 99.92 s and 893 tok/s aggregate with four; 30,720 tokens: 35.46 s and 866 tok/s alone (previous package 719), 141.38 s and 863 tok/s aggregate with four. Concurrent prefills do not overlap. With --prefill-srpt (off by default), four concurrent 30,720-token prompts get their first tokens at 36.17, 71.86, 107.64, 145.07 s instead of all at 139.70 to 142.39 s. Source: BENCHMARKS-SM70.md.
